rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 321 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (elections_public_opinion led 11-14, geopolitics 11-15, policy_regulation 11-16, so elections_public_opinion leads today, then geopolitics, then policy_regulation); within each group the list starts at offset 321 % group_size in pool order (elections 9 -> 6: platform AI labeling first; geopolitics 10 -> 1: US China AI competition first; policy 15 -> 6: algorithmic accountability first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-16, so items published 11-16 (after the prior harvest) through 11-17 are in scope. Context: Tuesday 11-17 in Korea / Monday 11-16 in the US and EU at harvest time — first full weekday of the week in the West, so expect agency releases, court orders and Federal Register public-inspection items dated 11-16, plus Korean Tuesday 국무회의 decisions and ministry releases dated 11-17. Hooks this week — only official documents are new, skip previews: CCW 7th Review Conference Geneva runs 11-16..20 (formal working papers, national statements and any adopted decision on LAWS posted by UNODA are new; explainers are not); APEC Shenzhen US-China summit 11-18..19 (skip agenda previews; only a signed statement is new); House closed briefing with Jensen Huang (now former Nvidia CEO per 11-16 coverage) on 11-18 (skip previews; only its outcome, subpoenas, or a formal bill markup is new); Meta AI-scraping terms take effect 11-20 (only a new regulator/court order is new); 중기부 모두의 창업 AI 공급사 49곳 보안점검 due 11-20 (only results or sanctions decisions are new); 국무총리 주재 AI 부정행위 관계부처 차관회의 held 11-16 (only a NEW measure beyond the 11-15 audit — e.g. a law/시행령 change, device-ban rule, 수능 rule — is new). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
